---
title: "3_QC_Preprocessing_RNAseq"
author: "Noor-Ul-Haya Ahmed"
date: "2026"
output: pdf_document
description: >
  Quality control and preprocessing of Illumina RNA-seq datasets.
  Raw counts are loaded, Ensembl IDs mapped to gene symbols,
  low-count genes filtered, and DESeq2 objects saved for
  differential expression analysis. VST transformation applied
  for QC visualisation only. Datasets: GSE100188 (ALS small RNA),
  GSE140089 (PD primary), GSE128177 (PD shared cohort).
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "...") # make own directory
```

```{r libraries}
# ============================================================
# LIBRARIES
# ============================================================
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

# create output directories
dir.create("QC",          showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("QC/RNAseq",   showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r load_metadata}
# ============================================================
# LOAD RNA-SEQ METADATA
# RNAseq_Sample_Metadata.csv contains Sample_ID, Group,
# Dataset columns for all RNA-seq samples
# ============================================================

rnaseq_meta <- read.csv(
  "metadata/RNAseq_Sample_Metadata.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

rnaseq_meta$Group     <- trimws(rnaseq_meta$Group)
rnaseq_meta$Sample_ID <- trimws(rnaseq_meta$Sample_ID)
rnaseq_meta$Dataset   <- trimws(rnaseq_meta$Dataset)

cat("RNA-seq metadata loaded:", nrow(rnaseq_meta), "samples\n")
```

```{r gse140089_pd_primary}
# ============================================================
# GSE140089 — PD SKELETAL MUSCLE (PRIMARY PD DATASET)
# n = 17 PD vs 24 controls
# featureCounts matrix, Ensembl IDs
# ============================================================

cat("\n=================================\n",
    "Processing: GSE140089 (PD primary)\n",
    "=================================\n")

# load counts
counts_140089 <- read.csv(
  "raw_data/GSE140089_counts.csv",
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)
counts_140089 <- as.matrix(counts_140089)
mode(counts_140089) <- "integer"

cat("Raw dimensions:", dim(counts_140089), "\n")

# map Ensembl to gene symbols
ensembl_ids <- gsub("\\..*", "", rownames(counts_140089))

symbols <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys      = ensembl_ids,
  column    = "SYMBOL",
  keytype   = "ENSEMBL",
  multiVals = "first"
)

counts_140089 <- counts_140089[!is.na(symbols), ]
rownames(counts_140089) <- symbols[!is.na(symbols)]

# remove duplicate gene symbols — keep highest mean count
counts_140089 <- counts_140089[
  !duplicated(rownames(counts_140089)),
]

cat("Genes after mapping:", nrow(counts_140089), "\n")

# match metadata
meta_140089 <- rnaseq_meta %>%
  filter(Dataset == "GSE140089",
         Group   %in% c("PD", "Control"),
         Sample_ID %in% colnames(counts_140089))

counts_140089 <- counts_140089[, meta_140089$Sample_ID]

cat("Samples:", ncol(counts_140089), "\n")
cat("PD:", sum(meta_140089$Group == "PD"), "\n")
cat("Control:", sum(meta_140089$Group == "Control"), "\n")

# filter low count genes
keep <- rowSums(counts_140089 >= 10) >= 3
counts_140089 <- counts_140089[keep, ]
cat("Genes after filtering:", nrow(counts_140089), "\n")

# build DESeq2 object
dds_140089 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_140089,
  colData   = meta_140089,
  design    = ~ Group
)
dds_140089$Group <- factor(dds_140089$Group,
                            levels = c("Control", "PD"))

# VST for QC only
vst_140089 <- vst(dds_140089, blind = TRUE)

# PCA
pca_data <- plotPCA(vst_140089,
                     intgroup = "Group",
                     returnData = TRUE)
pct_var <- round(100 * attr(pca_data, "percentVar"), 1)

p <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "GSE140089 PCA (VST)",
    x     = paste0("PC1 (", pct_var[1], "%)"),
    y     = paste0("PC2 (", pct_var[2], "%)")
  )

ggsave("QC/RNAseq/GSE140089_PCA.png",
       plot = p, width = 10, height = 8)

# save DESeq2 object
saveRDS(dds_140089, "QC/RNAseq/GSE140089_dds.rds")
cat("Saved GSE140089 dds object\n")
```

```{r gse128177_pd_shared}
# ============================================================
# GSE128177 — PD SKELETAL MUSCLE (SHARED COHORT)
# n = 12 PD vs 12 OA controls (age-matched only)
# NOTE: shares subjects with GSE140089 — not independent
# NOTE: young adult controls excluded to remove age confound
# ============================================================

cat("\n=================================\n",
    "Processing: GSE128177 (PD shared cohort)\n",
    "=================================\n")

counts_128177 <- read.csv(
  "raw_data/GSE128177_counts.csv",
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)
counts_128177 <- as.matrix(counts_128177)
mode(counts_128177) <- "integer"

# map Ensembl to symbols
ensembl_ids <- gsub("\\..*", "", rownames(counts_128177))
symbols <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                   keys      = ensembl_ids,
                   column    = "SYMBOL",
                   keytype   = "ENSEMBL",
                   multiVals = "first")

counts_128177 <- counts_128177[!is.na(symbols), ]
rownames(counts_128177) <- symbols[!is.na(symbols)]
counts_128177 <- counts_128177[!duplicated(rownames(counts_128177)), ]

# load age-stratified metadata
# OA controls only retained to eliminate age confound
meta_128177_oa <- read.csv(
  "metadata/GSE128177_OA_metadata.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

meta_128177_fixed <- meta_128177_oa %>%
  filter(Group %in% c("PD", "Control_Old")) %>%
  mutate(Group = ifelse(Group == "Control_Old", "Control", "PD"))

counts_128177 <- counts_128177[,
  colnames(counts_128177) %in% meta_128177_fixed$Sample_ID]

meta_128177_fixed <- meta_128177_fixed[
  match(colnames(counts_128177), meta_128177_fixed$Sample_ID),
]

cat("PD:", sum(meta_128177_fixed$Group == "PD"), "\n")
cat("Control (OA only):", sum(meta_128177_fixed$Group == "Control"), "\n")

keep <- rowSums(counts_128177 >= 10) >= 3
counts_128177 <- counts_128177[keep, ]

dds_128177 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_128177,
  colData   = meta_128177_fixed,
  design    = ~ Group
)
dds_128177$Group <- factor(dds_128177$Group,
                            levels = c("Control", "PD"))

saveRDS(dds_128177, "QC/RNAseq/GSE128177_dds.rds")
cat("Saved GSE128177 dds object\n")
```

```{r gse100188_als_smallrna}
# ============================================================
# GSE100188 — ALS SKELETAL MUSCLE SMALL RNA-SEQ
# n = 11 ALS vs 11 controls
# Analysed as separate track — not combined with mRNA datasets
# ============================================================

cat("\n=================================\n",
    "Processing: GSE100188 (ALS small RNA)\n",
    "=================================\n")

meta_100188 <- rnaseq_meta %>%
  filter(Dataset == "GSE100188")

cat("ALS:", sum(meta_100188$Group == "ALS"), "\n")
cat("Control:", sum(meta_100188$Group == "Control"), "\n")

# NOTE: GSE100188 counts extracted from deposited Excel file
# Count columns identified using grep("Count", colnames())
# See download script for extraction details

cat("GSE100188 metadata loaded — counts extracted separately\n")
cat("See 1_download_datasets.Rmd for count extraction code\n")
```
